args.body: generation 3: The theorem names its own escape: break the time-reversal symmetry. A rotating helix traces a loop in configuration space rather than retracing a line, and a loop encloses area, and enclosed area is displacement. That is what a flagellum is. Declare the cycle too, so the arithmetic can be checked against the speed asked for.
